itinerary.title: Drive from Cairo to Bahariya
itinerary.source: The night is spent at a Bahariya hotel.

itinerary.title: Golden Mummies, Black and White Desert
itinerary.source: Camp is set up among them for the night, in the open desert, with the chalk shapes visible by moonlight.

itinerary.title: West to Djara Cave: the deep desert
itinerary.source: Camp is made beside Djara Cave, some 150 kilometres from the White Desert camp.

itinerary.title: Djara Cave, drive back to Bahariya
itinerary.source: The night is spent at a hotel in the oasis, which registers as genuine comfort after two nights under canvas.

itinerary.title: Back to Cairo
itinerary.source: A final breakfast in Bahariya, then the four-hour drive northeast back to Cairo.
